## About
State Fair Auto Parts is a used auto parts store on John R St in Detroit. We carry used, new and aftermarket parts for all makes and models, foreign and domestic, including cars, light trucks and vans.
Parts come with a warranty, and if you're not in Detroit, we ship nationwide. Customers have rated us 4 from 64 Google reviews, and one of them calls us a hidden gem in the city.

## Services
- Foreign and domestic makes and models: A large selection for foreign and domestic cars, light trucks and vans.
- Reconditioned batteries: One customer came in for a dead battery and left with a reconditioned one that carried a 6-month guarantee, after we showed him it was working.
- We ship nationwide: Not near Detroit? We can send your part to you.

## FAQ
Q: How long do I have to return a part under warranty?
A: Parts returned under warranty need to come back within 30 days from the date of sale.

Q: Can I return electrical or body parts?
A: No. We don't accept returns on electrical or body parts, so call us first if you're not sure what you need.
